user.title: Industrial Alarm Panel
user.description: Set up the DCS-style alarm annunciator.

abort.already_configured: Industrial Alarm Panel is already configured.

data_description.media_sound_url: URL played on the selected media players, e.g. /local/alarms/[priority].mp3. [priority] is replaced by critical, high, medium, low, info or status. No audio files are shipped: place your own files in /config/www/ (served as /local/). Leave empty to disable media player sound.
data_description.max_active_alarms: Display limit for the panel's active alarm list.
data_description.max_history_rows: Display page size for the panel's history list; stored history is pruned by retention days.
data_description.history_retention_days: Alarm history older than this is deleted by a daily cleanup.
data_description.store_normal_events: Also record a history row for every source value change that does not change the alarm state (can be noisy).
data_description.repeat_until_silenced: Re-play the media player sound every repeat interval until the horn is silenced or all alarms are acknowledged.
data_description.default_delay_on_seconds: Applied to new rules that do not specify an ON delay.
data_description.default_delay_off_seconds: Applied to new rules that do not specify an OFF delay.
data_description.default_deadband: Applied to new rules that do not specify a deadband.
data_description.flapping_detection_threshold: Activations within 5 minutes that mark an alarm as flapping.

silence_horn.description: Stop alarm sound without acknowledging active alarms.

duration_seconds.name: Duration
duration_seconds.description: Silence for this many seconds; omit to silence until the next new alarm.

unsilence_horn.name: Unsilence horn
unsilence_horn.description: Re-enable horn output for currently audible alarms.

shelve_alarm.name: Shelve alarm
shelve_alarm.description: Temporarily suppress an alarm rule; it unshelves automatically when the duration expires.

comment.name: Comment
comment.description: Optional operator comment stored in history.

unshelve_alarm.name: Unshelve alarm
unshelve_alarm.description: Return a shelved alarm to service and re-evaluate its source.

comment.name: Comment
comment.description: Optional operator comment stored in history.

enable_alarm.name: Enable alarm
enable_alarm.description: Enable a disabled alarm rule and re-evaluate its source.

create_rule.name: Create rule
create_rule.description: Create an alarm rule (admin only when called by a user).

update_rule.name: Update rule
update_rule.description: Update an alarm rule (admin only when called by a user).
